questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "ABUNDANT"
questions.explanation: ABUNDANT का अर्थ होता है प्रचुर, प्रचुर मात्रा में या बहुयात। Synonym: Plentiful, Copious, Bountiful, Ample.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "ABUNDANT"
questions.explanation: ABUNDANT (प्रचुर) का Antonym है Scarce (दुर्लभ/कम) या Meagre (अल्प).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "BELLIGERENT"
questions.explanation: BELLIGERENT का अर्थ होता है लड़ाकू, आक्रामक या युद्धरत। Synonym: Hostile, Pugnacious, Aggressive, Bellicose.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "BELLIGERENT"
questions.explanation: BELLIGERENT (आक्रामक/लड़ाकू) का Antonym है Peaceful (शांतिप्रिय) या Friendly.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "COMPETENT"
questions.explanation: COMPETENT का अर्थ होता है सक्षम, योग्य या निपुण। Synonym: Capable, Efficient, Proficient, Able.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "COMPETENT"
questions.explanation: COMPETENT (योग्य/सक्षम) का Antonym है Incompetent (अयोग्य) या Inefficient.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "DUBIOUS"
questions.explanation: DUBIOUS का अर्थ होता है संदिग्ध, शंकास्पद या अनिश्चित। Synonym: Doubtful, Suspicious, Questionable.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "DUBIOUS"
questions.explanation: DUBIOUS (संदिग्ध) का Antonym है Certain (निश्चित) या Sure.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A furnace, oven or brick enclosure used for baking, drying or burning pottery and bricks"
questions.explanation: ईंटों या मिट्टी के बर्तनों को पकाने वाली भट्टी को Kiln कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A collection of wild, rare or exotic animals kept in captivity for public exhibition"
questions.explanation: प्रदर्शनी हेतु रखे गए जंगली जानवरों के संग्रह को Menagerie कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who lives in complete solitude and seclusion away from human society"
questions.explanation: समाज से अलग एकांत में रहने वाले वैरागी/एकांतवासी को Recluse या Hermit कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who is able to speak two languages fluently"
questions.explanation: दो भाषाएँ बोलने वाले व्यक्ति को Bilingual (द्विभाषी) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who speaks or knows only one language"
questions.explanation: केवल एक भाषा बोलने वाले को Monolingual कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Through thick and thin"
options: In all circumstances and conditions, whether good or bad
questions.explanation: Through thick and thin = हर सुख-दुख और हर परिस्थिति में।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Under the weather"
questions.explanation: Under the weather = बीमार होना, अस्वस्थ होना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Wild goose chase"
options: A foolish and hopeless search or pursuit
To hunt wild geese in the forest
questions.explanation: Wild goose chase = व्यर्थ और निष्फल खोज या प्रयास।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Back to the drawing board"
options: To draw a picture on board
Start planning all over again from the beginning
questions.explanation: Back to the drawing board = योजना में असफलता के बाद फिर से नए सिरे से काम शुरू करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "The ball is in your court"
options: To win a game of tennis
It is now your turn to make a decision or take action
To pass responsibility to someone else
questions.explanation: The ball is in your court = अब निर्णय/कदम उठाने की बारी आपकी है।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "He is one of the most intelligent boy in the class."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'One of the' के बाद Plural Noun ('boys') का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "Neither Ram nor Shyam have submitted the fee."
questions.explanation: Rule: Neither...nor में निकटतम सिंगुलर सब्जेक्ट 'Shyam' के अनुसार Singular Verb 'has' आएगा।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "She has been ill from last week."
questions.explanation: Rule: निश्चित बिंदु ('last week') के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'since' आता है (since last week).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He is junior _____ all his team members."
questions.explanation: Rule: Junior, Senior, Superior के साथ preposition 'to' आता है (Junior to all).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She is proficient _____ English grammar and writing."
questions.explanation: Rule: Adjective 'Proficient' के साथ preposition 'in' का प्रयोग होता है (Proficient in English).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "The dog barked _____ the stranger at night."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Bark' के साथ preposition 'at' आता है (Bark at someone).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "EXEMPLARY"
questions.explanation: EXEMPLARY का अर्थ होता है अनुकरणीय, प्रशंसनीय या आदर्श। Synonym: Model, Commendable, Praiseworthy.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "EXEMPLARY"
questions.explanation: EXEMPLARY (प्रशंसनीय) का Antonym है Deplorable (निंदनीय) या Blameworthy.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "FUTILE"
questions.explanation: FUTILE का अर्थ होता है व्यर्थ, निष्फल या निरर्थक। Synonym: Useless, Ineffective, Vain, Fruitless.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "FUTILE"
questions.explanation: FUTILE (व्यर्थ) का Antonym है Fruitful (फलदायी) या Effective.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A scholar who compiles dictionaries"
questions.explanation: शब्दकोश संकलनकर्ता को Lexicographer कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who designs, draws or prepares maps"
questions.explanation: मानचित्रकार को Cartographer कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A scientist who studies human societies, origin and development of human culture"
questions.explanation: मानव विज्ञान/संस्कृति के अध्ययनकर्ता को Anthropologist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A scientist who studies heavenly bodies, stars and planets in space"
questions.explanation: खगोलशास्त्री को Astronomer कहते हैं (Astrologer = ज्योतिषी)।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Burn the candle at both ends"
options: To work tirelessly without taking proper rest or sleep
To light a room from both sides
questions.explanation: Burn the candle at both ends = दिन-रात एक करके अत्यधिक परिश्रम करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Costs an arm and a leg"
questions.explanation: Costs an arm and a leg = अत्यधिक महँगा होना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Don't put all your eggs in one basket"
options: Don't carry eggs in a basket
Don't risk everything on a single plan or venture
questions.explanation: Don't put all your eggs in one basket = सारा जोखिम एक ही काम में न लगाना।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "The teacher said that the sun <u>rose</u> in the east."
questions.explanation: Rule: सार्वभौमिक सत्य (Universal Truth) का Tense सदैव Present Simple (rises) रहता है।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "He did not <u>opened</u> the letter yesterday."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Did not' के साथ हमेशा Verb की 1st form ('open') का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "They have completed the project."
options: The project had been completed by them.
The project is completed by them.
The project was completed by them.
The project has been completed by them.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect (have + V3) का Passive = Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "She reads the newspaper every morning."
options: The newspaper was read by her every morning.
The newspaper is being read by her every morning.
The newspaper is read by her every morning.
The newspaper has been read by her.
questions.explanation: Present Simple (reads) का Passive = Object + is/am/are + V3 (read) + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said to me, "Can you help me?"
options: He told me if I could help him.
He asked me that if I could help him.
He asked me can I help him.
He asked me if I could help him.
questions.explanation: Interrogative Auxiliary verb (Can) से शुरू वाक्य का Indirect = asked + if + I (Subject) + could help him.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: The doctor said to the patient, "Take this medicine daily."
options: The doctor ordered the patient take this medicine daily.
The doctor told to the patient to take that medicine daily.
The doctor advised the patient taking medicine.
The doctor advised the patient to take that medicine daily.
questions.explanation: Imperative sentence (Advice) का Indirect = advised + the patient + to take that medicine daily.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "INSIPID"
questions.explanation: INSIPID का अर्थ होता है फीका, बेस्वाद या नीरस। Synonym: Tasteless, Bland, Flavorless, Dull.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "INSIPID"
questions.explanation: INSIPID (फीका) का Antonym है Tasty (स्वादिष्ट) या Delicious.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A substance or medicine given to counteract the effect of poison"
questions.explanation: विष-नाशक औषधि को Antidote कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A word, law or custom that is no longer in active general use"
questions.explanation: अप्रचलित/पुरानी प्रथा या शब्द को Obsolete कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Anything or food item that is fit or safe to be eaten"
questions.explanation: खाने योग्य वस्तु को Edible कहते हैं (पीने योग्य जल = Potable).

questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी GUARANTEE (गारंटी) है।
